**Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd.** is a prominent and highly respected entity in the Indian chemical landscape, serving as a cornerstone for industrial raw material supply and distribution. Strategically headquartered in the industrial heartland of India, the company operates from its corporate office located at **102 Sudhan Apartment, Opposite Tejas School, Race Course, Baroda-390007, Gujarat**. Since its inception, the company has dedicated itself to bridging the gap between high-grade chemical manufacturing and the diverse requirements of the modern industrial sector.

Operating in Baroda (Vadodara)—a city globally recognized as the "Chemical Capital of India"—Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. leverages its geographic advantage to maintain a robust supply chain network. The company specializes in the procurement, storage, and distribution of a wide array of industrial acids, solvents, and specialty chemicals. Their product portfolio is designed to cater to a multidisciplinary range of sectors, including pharmaceutical formulation, textile processing, dye intermediates, water treatment, and agro-based industries.

What sets Minol Acid And Chemicals apart is its unwavering commitment to quality assurance and logistical efficiency. In an industry where the purity of chemical composition is paramount, the company ensures that every batch of material meets stringent national and international safety standards. By maintaining a professional presence in the Race Course area of Baroda, they provide easy accessibility to partners and clients, fostering long-term business relationships built on trust, transparency, and technical expertise.

The company’s growth is fueled by a deep understanding of market dynamics in Gujarat and beyond. By combining decades of industry experience with a forward-thinking approach to chemical trading, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. continues to be a preferred partner for enterprises looking for reliable chemical solutions that drive production and innovation. Whether it is bulk acid supplies or specialized chemical compounds, the company remains a vital link in India’s industrial value chain.
